study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: Combined method of blood loss estimation (direct measurements, sucker bottle volumes, weighing surgical towels/drapes)
Calculation from preoperative and postoperative hemoglobin levels
cohort: 156 women undergoing prepartum lower-segment Cesarean delivery (LSCD) at 37-39 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: Visual assessment of estimated blood loss (EBL) by anesthesiologists had the best intraclass correlation and limits of agreement with the combined method, which was concluded to be the ideal method for EBL estimation.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken during and immediately after Cesarean delivery, with data collected between January 21 and April 30, 2013.
